limits: No target DLL, native GUI, font renderer or original generated HTML execution.

Collection iteration/delegates, primitive storage, constructors for structs/closures, matrix arithmetic, cubic extrema and rectangle union are explicit JavaScript sinks. Source-backed CIL controls topology, pruning, indexing, selectors and hN4K/iN4x normalization orchestration.
Numeric curve-bounds sink uses independent polynomial extrema; native tiny-polynomial solver edge parity belongs to frozen prior evidence, not this probe.
Empty outer input is a geometry-function behavior; ordinary Kj3n with jj3z=false and no input nodes does not call TN46. Empty inner contour reaches native Last(empty) exception.
Authored M/L/C/Z carrier adapter is an explicit independent representation choice: unavailable inactive handles are NaN, not a claim about a native SVG importer.
Full editor lifecycle, native history, special jj3z/tj3j gesture states and generic affine transforms are outside these bounded cases.
